purpose: Determine, without selecting or promoting a fraction, whether any linear mixture of the current local and routed source endpoints can make the spent real-map DDO154 field competitive with algebraic MOND.

equation.boundary: fixed-RAR point-mass boundary shared by both endpoints

registered_marker.meaning: P0693 projected spectral fraction; reproduction marker only

decision_rule.promotion: No atlas row may advance, be selected as a routing constant, or be described as validation.
decision_rule.retire_shared_linear_endpoint_pair: yes if zero preregistered rows pass every diagnostic viability gate
decision_rule.if_any_row_is_viable: report only a response interval that a future baryon-derived spatial law must predict; freeze that law jointly before any new score
decision_rule.if_no_row_is_viable: retire linear mixtures of S_local and S_route as a galaxy-cluster unifier and replace the galaxy radial endpoint/operator
decision_rule.sealed_targets: P0633 and P0640 remain sealed regardless of the atlas result

claim_boundary: DDO154 is fully spent development evidence.
A viable row would be post-hoc diagnostic evidence and cannot become a selected universal setting.
Finite sampling cannot mathematically exclude an arbitrarily narrow interval between rows.
No P0633 or P0640 outcome is opened.
